primary_strengths: Entity extraction and basic geometry metrics
Material yield calculation with panel rotation detection
Layer_card mapping with tool_config (color → cutter type)
critical_issues: Proximity_matrix contains only zeros for most shape groups
Tool assignment conflict: same entities assigned to both vibrate cutter and V-slot (color mapping vs geometry logic)
Graph_connected_components sometimes wrong (e.g., 9 components for a single cluster)
Duplicated zones (identical entity sets appear in multiple zones)

critical_issues.title: Empty nesting_tree
critical_issues.description: nesting_tree is always empty, even when containment edges exist (e.g., child-parent relationships).
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Recursively build nesting_tree from containment edges. Include all entities (parents and children).

critical_issues.title: Proximity matrix all zeros
critical_issues.description: proximity_matrix has zeros for most shape group pairs, except a few cases. In some outputs, entire matrix is zero.
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Compute minimum Euclidean distance between convex hulls or bounding boxes of shape groups. Use spatial index (e.g., STRtree) for efficiency.

critical_issues.title: Tool assignment conflict
critical_issues.description: Entities are assigned to both 'vibrate_cutter_0deg' (based on layer color) and 'v_slot_45deg' (based on geometry: open paths). This makes output ambiguous for operators.
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Define clear priority: if color is mapped to a cutter in layer_card, that overrides geometry heuristic. Otherwise, fallback to geometry. Add a 'tool_conflict_detected' boolean flag when both rules apply.

critical_issues.title: Tool_summary missing correct total_length
critical_issues.description: For V-slot, total_length_mm = 0, but single_pass_length_mm and double_pass_length_mm are correct.
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Set total_length_mm = single_pass_length_mm for consistency, or remove the field entirely.

critical_issues.title: Wrong graph_connected_components
critical_issues.description: In some panels (e.g., tmp1943cdvv.dxf), graph_connected_components=9 but all entities belong to one spatial cluster. Components counted only from adjacency/containment, not from intersection.
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Build graph using intersection edges (bbox overlaps) and proximity (if distance < threshold). Then compute connected components.

critical_issues.title: Duplicated zones
critical_issues.description: Same set of entity_ids appears in multiple zones (e.g., Z2 and Z3 identical).
critical_issues.suggested_fix: Cluster zones such that each entity belongs to exactly one zone. Merge zones with identical entity sets.

minor_issues.title: Regularity_score can be negative
minor_issues.description: Negative values (e.g., -4.477) are mathematically possible but unclear meaning. Document or clamp to [0,1] if intended as normalized score.
minor_issues.suggested_fix: Document that negative values indicate anti‑regularity, or transform to 0–1 range.

minor_issues.title: min_feature_width_mm always zero
minor_issues.suggested_fix: Implement via distance transform or minimum distance between entities (from proximity matrix).

minor_issues.title: Inconsistent naming of bbox fields
minor_issues.description: global_bbox_mm uses absolute coordinates, panel_bbox_mm uses relative dimensions. Same name causes confusion.

for_v2.3: Fix C3 (tool assignment conflict) – highest priority for production
Add tool_conflict_detected flag and warning in narrative_summary
for_v2.4: Add feature extraction for ML: point_density_per_meter, open_closed_ratio, cut_density_per_m2
Add cutting_time sub‑features (vibrate_time, vslot_time, head_rotation_time) to CSV

suggested_layers: Feature extraction (→ ML vector, JSON index, MD summary)
architecture.benefits: Separate concerns, enable CLI/batch processing, easier integration with Odoo ERP.

known_limitations: Does not detect holes in polygons (num_holes always 0)
No handling of multiple stock plates (panel larger than one sheet yields yield_percent=null)
Feed rate hardcoded (200 mm/s) – should be configurable per material/thickness
No validation of nested contours (max_nesting_depth = 0 for all samples)

2. After fixes, generate test suite with the 8 sample DXF files.
3. Update version to 2.3.0 and deploy to GCP Cloud Run.
4. Integrate with Odoo via REST API (FastAPI endpoint).
